page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores, operating with a single thread per core. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core.

Acceleration is delivered via a single integrated NVIDIA P4 GPU featuring 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

From a resource density perspective, this instance offers a dedicated compute profile paired with entry-level GPU acceleration, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads requiring hardware acceleration without the overhead of high-end GPU architectures. It is suited for workloads such as small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, and GPU-assisted rendering or general-purpose compute tasks that benefit from parallel processing.
